## Authority and source reconciliation

The normalized local inventory and two invariants control the common contract, not the strictest candidate or a self-reported PASS. Actual counts are 194 distinct inventory IDs in 10 groups plus GOV-017/GOV-018 (MUST), totaling 196 unique IDs. All six 43-file source trees are byte-identical. Every current CANDIDATE.md equals baseline/CANDIDATE.md, and all baseline TASK.md copies agree. Essential local inputs exist. The unavailable historical research citation does not remove the locally embedded invariant authority.

The CSV is a static clause-level evidence map, not 196/196 executed passes. SAME means the cited current owner expresses an equivalent obligation under the recorded trigger/scope and chosen stack; it does not certify live delivery or generated behavior. DIFFERENT identifies an extra exception/constraint relative to the normalized rule. UNVERIFIED preserves unresolved force/exception wording. Conditional policies remain represented when dormant in an empty template. Comparison assumes identical specification, repository, .NET/C#/SQL Server/NUnit/Angular selection, acceptance tests and model. An optional frontend slot never licenses ignoring an explicit Angular product requirement.

Source mapping replaces templates/v2-baseline/ with the existing local source/v2-baseline/. All corresponding cited files exist. Only research/observations/002-candidate-space-analysis.md, cited by GOV-017/018, is unavailable locally; it was not fetched. Embedded normalized MUST invariant text controls. No essential input is missing.

Current candidate definitions equal baseline definitions; baseline TASK.md copies agree. Provenance identifies Run-02 history. M README's older population wording and L1-Restart's inherited L1 label are historical, not evidence of missing current artifacts. Recorded historical source-tree digests cannot be compared to our current digest without matching serialization. Direct current path/byte comparison independently establishes equality. K1 provenance task_sha256 `579b723fde56866f0f8dcc30a619ad6abae8579622c0af102054604baef81a5c` matches baseline/TASK.md. Optional manifest discrepancies below have an unverified historical cause.

## Inventory and SHA-256 method

The initial snapshot preceded mutable test execution. It contains 1230 input files: all 448 final-template files, sources, baselines and candidate-root inputs. No symlinks/junctions were found by the bounded walk or followed. After tests, every snapshotted file retained its SHA-256 and remained present. Final-template path sets also match: zero added, deleted or changed. This proves read-only behavior during this audit, not historical authoring provenance.

Tree serialization: sort relative POSIX paths ordinally, concatenate `SHA256 + two spaces + relative_path + LF` for each entry, then SHA-256 the UTF-8 result. Before/after use the same method. Earlier JSON-map or sha256sum-pipeline digests may differ solely through serialization.

## Policy mapping and confidence

Actual inventory group counts (invariants excluded):

| Group | IDs |
|---|---:|
| governance-product | 19 |
| architecture | 29 |
| persistence-data | 10 |
| api-errors-validation | 22 |
| testing-quality | 12 |
| security | 18 |
| runtime-code-performance | 24 |
| dependencies-stack | 26 |
| frontend | 12 |
| workflows-delivery | 22 |


Actual IDs/group cardinalities and invariant non-overlap were parsed, not inferred from declared counts. Each unique ID has one CSV row with original strength, trigger and scope. Current owner clauses were compared with normalized semantics, including contextual workflows and split neutral/concrete bindings. An index and lexical ranking aided navigation, never passed a policy. Candidate POLICY_MAP claims and ownership headers were not themselves evidence of behavioral equivalence. The final evidence field contains current owner quotations, with curated windows for compound clauses. WORDING_ONLY means no material normalized-obligation difference established in the static review, not identical prose or certified runtime behavior.

All 448 files were enumerated/indexed. Substantive review focused on current rules, workflows, bindings, build assets, hooks and checkers; not every tutorial example was independently validated. Complete historical V2 preservation and live triggers remain U-05/U-01. Static SAME may coexist with unverified runtime delivery. LOW severity on ordinary rows means no material gap established, not a low-severity defect.

M1/TST-005 and L1-Restart/WF-019 are explicitly UNVERIFIED. Build-related rows retain SAME for the common textual obligation and UNCERTAIN parity classification because diagnostic effects were not executed. Dormant conditional policies are still mapped: absence of an application is not proof that backend/frontend rules are NOT_APPLICABLE to future tasks. Resilience, versioning, relational fidelity and migrations are compared only under their triggers.

## Test interpretation

Every record contains command arguments, cwd, stdin event, intended expectation, actual exit/output and audited disposition. Embedded harness source defines fixtures. CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and event cwd identify the temp copy; GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES prevents upward repository discovery. Subprocess timeout was 15 seconds; none timed out. State hooks may retain prior fixture state within a copy, so removed-manifest/approval reminders are expected alongside the targeted version/direction assertion. K0's missing-hook negative also reports empty fixture directories; that is disclosed fixture residue.

Syntax/pristine output is candidate-authored diagnostics run by the independent harness. Edits, positive/negative cases and interpretations are independent fixtures. additionalContext, ask/deny, nonzero stderr and quiet responses were interpreted according to candidate contracts. A legal edge without recorded approval is not a fully authorized mutation.

The initial Technique: backend-testing.framework expectation was inapplicable in L1 Architecture: its documented reverse-reference exemption uses Framework binding with backticks. One reconfirmation passed. No concrete-technology pointer exemption was allowed. K0's comment false positive is the only failing behavior in this corpus; its two FAIL records are one issue. The M1 normative blocker is a static finding, not a checker-fixture failure.

Totals: {"PASS": 261, "FAIL": 2, "NOT_APPLICABLE": 1}. Recorded subprocess fixtures: 264. Setup and inventory commands are not included in this count.

## Not run / not fully verified

| ID | Disposition | Material boundary |
|---|---|---|
| U-01 | NOT_RUN | Live Claude host execution, settings-schema acceptance, automatic loading and approval UI. Scripts were invoked with discovered settings arguments; no host launched. |
| U-02 | NOT_RUN | Physical linked worktrees, wrong launcher versus active root, nested-cwd switching, HEAD/branch resets, UTF-16 input, full Stop state transitions. Temp copies used independent git-init repositories without commits. UTF-8 BOM was tested. |
| U-03 | NOT_RUN | Optional-frontend removal, implementation replacement, missing-binds negative suite, coordinated contract/manifest tampering. Current selected structures inspected and pristine checkers ran. |
| U-04 | NOT_RUN | Exhaustive Kind/Level conformance and private-reference negative permutations. P4 and a documented neutral-binding control tested; no complete relation proof. |
| U-05 | UNVERIFIED | Full historical V2 technique/example preservation and strict improvement over every frozen baseline behavior. Normalized policy mapping and current source equality established; exhaustive historical equivalence not proved. |
| U-06 | NOT_RUN | Paired generation, application builds/tests, real database/provider behavior, CI execution, measured code quality. No application generation, restore, network, or model invocation allowed. |
| U-07 | UNVERIFIED | Evaluated MSBuild imports/conditions, custom props/targets, malformed XML corpus, runtime resolution of every symbolic facet. Finite probes covered literal csproj and Directory.Packages.props; broad security globs do not imply parsing every extension. |

No unsupported test is represented as PASS. NOT_APPLICABLE denotes one corrected fixture expectation, not missing policy. PAR-004/005/006 are three additional uncertain comparison observations.

## Reproducible harnesses

For the dynamic harness, a minimal state.json is an object with `root` equal to the exact audit root and `candidates` equal to `["M","M1","L0","L1-Restart","K0","K1"]`; tests.py creates copies from those inputs. Run supplemental.py after tests.py. The static finish_checks.py additionally requires the initial full file-hash snapshot and parsed text index; the evidence manifests and method document their construction. Do not reuse stale tracking state between independent reproductions.

These are evidence, not instructions to mutate source candidates. Recreate only a dedicated disposable copy area. Initial harness used the stable OS TEMP of its process. Input snapshot JSON records root and candidate names; its per-template hash content is embedded below.

### finish_checks.py

```python
import pathlib,json,re,hashlib,collections,subprocess,os
W=pathlib.Path(r'C:\Users\atonkonog\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-final-audit-005-53');S=json.loads((W/'state.json').read_text());D=json.loads((W/'index.json').read_text());R=pathlib.Path(S['root'])
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def digest(m):return hashlib.sha256(''.join(f'{m[k]}  {k}\n' for k in sorted(m)).encode()).hexdigest()
A={'root':str(pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()),'environment':{},'templates':{},'manifests':{},'source_refs_missing':{},'imports':{},'glob_probe':{},'after':{'changed':[],'missing':[],'added':[]},'sources':{}}
assert pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()==R.resolve()
for cmd in [['node','--version'],['python','--version'],['git','--version']]:A['environment'][' '.join(cmd)]=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
A['environment']['OS']=os.name;A['environment']['shell']='Windows PowerShell';A['environment']['network']='Not used'
for c in S['candidates']:
 before=S['files'][c]
 for name,h in before.items():
  p=R/name
  if not p.exists():A['after']['missing'].append(name)
  elif sha(p)!=h:A['after']['changed'].append(name)
 template={name.split('/output/template/',1)[1]:h for name,h in before.items() if '/output/template/' in name}
 actual={p.relative_to(R/c/'output/template').as_posix():sha(p) for p in (R/c/'output/template').rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()}
 A['after']['added'] += [c+'/output/template/'+k for k in actual.keys()-template.keys()]
 assert actual==template
 A['templates'][c]={'count':len(template),'bytes':sum((R/c/'output/template'/f).stat().st_size for f in template),'digest':digest(template),'files':template}
 source={name.split('/source/',1)[1]:h for name,h in before.items() if '/source/' in name}
 baseline={name.split('/baseline/',1)[1]:h for name,h in before.items() if '/baseline/' in name}
 A['sources'][c]={'source_count':len(source),'source_digest':digest(source),'baseline_count':len(baseline),'baseline_digest':digest(baseline),'candidate_equals_baseline':sha(R/c/'CANDIDATE.md')==sha(R/c/'baseline/CANDIDATE.md')}
 p=R/c/'MANIFEST.sha256';m={'present':p.exists(),'matched':0,'mismatched':[],'skipped':0}
 if p.exists():
  for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
   hit=re.match(r'([a-fA-F0-9]{64})\s+\*?(.+)',line)
   if not hit:continue
   rel=c+'/'+hit[2]
   if rel not in before:m['skipped']+=1;continue
   if before[rel]==hit[1].lower():m['matched']+=1
   else:m['mismatched'].append({'file':rel,'recorded':hit[1],'actual':sha(R/rel)})
 A['manifests'][c]=m
 A['imports'][c]=[{'file':f,'exists':(R/c/'output/template'/f).is_file()} for f in D['imports'][c]]
 # Independent static glob interpretation: ordinary **/ may match zero or more directories.
 patterns=[]
 for f,t in D['docs'][c].items():
  if '/rules/' in f and t.startswith('---'):
   for line in t.split('---')[1].splitlines():
    if line.strip().startswith('- '):patterns.append((f,line.strip()[2:].strip('"\'')))
 def match(p,s):
  x=re.escape(p).replace(r'\*\*/','(?:.*/)?').replace(r'\*\*','.*').replace(r'\*','[^/]*').replace(r'\?','[^/]');return re.fullmatch(x,s) is not None
 paths=['backend/App.Application/Service.cs','backend/App.Application.Tests/ServiceTests.cs','backend/App.Application/App.Application.csproj','frontend/App.Web/src/app/app.ts','Directory.Packages.props','Directory.Build.props']
 A['glob_probe'][c]={p:sorted(set(f for f,g in patterns if match(g,p))) for p in paths}
for p in D['policies']:
 for ref in p.get('source_refs',[]):
  f=ref.split('#')[0].replace('templates/v2-baseline/','source/v2-baseline/')
  if not (R/'M'/f).is_file():A['source_refs_missing'].setdefault(f,[]).append(p['id'])
A['snapshot_files']=sum(len(m) for m in S['files'].values());A['links_skipped']=S['links']
assert not any(A['after'].values())
(W/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(A,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in A.items() if k not in ['templates','glob_probe','imports']},indent=2))
```
